value.statement: For every real s, Hsrc^s and H^s consist of the same periodic distributions, identified by equal Fourier coefficients, and ||h||_(Hsrc^s)=sqrt(2*pi)||h||_(H^s). At s=0 this identifies L2src with L2; the same constant scales time-supremum norms and norms of distributional time derivatives. Reality and zero mean are preserved.
